data.name: Hive Striker: Dissonance
data.detailed_description:
Build. Survive. Strike back.

Hive Striker: Dissonance is a top-down real-time strategy game where survivors establish a foothold in a post-apocalyptic wasteland overrun by an alien force known as The Dissonance. Deploy your Mobile Command Bunker, gather resources, build your base, train units, and push through enemy defenses to destroy the central hive.

KEY FEATURES

Base Building & Resource Management

Construct over 20 different buildings — barracks, fabricators, generators, walls, turrets, and more. Gather food and materials from the wasteland. Manage supply chains to keep your army fed and your machines powered.

Military Command

Train combat squads from militia to rocket troops, and deploy powerful machines like the Scrapwalker, Tesla Coil, and Mortar Rig. Research upgrades to unlock advanced units and abilities.

Fight The Dissonance

Face waves of alien enemies that grow stronger over time. Destroy Dissonance Spikes, break through shielded Resonators, and push to the NullPoint — the heart of the hive. Every wave survived brings you closer to victory.

Multiplayer (Up to 8 Players)

Team up with friends in online co-op or compete in PvP skirmishes. Form alliances, share territory, and coordinate attacks through Steam lobbies with integrated chat.

Tech Tree & Loot

Research new technologies, unlock abilities for your units, and collect loot drops from destroyed enemy structures. Every match plays differently based on your strategy.

Multiple Maps

Battle across distinct environments — from arid deserts to alien-infested hive lands — each with unique terrain and strategic challenges.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 10 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 760 / AMD Radeon R7 260X (2 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 10 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 (4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains military combat with weapons, unit deaths, and base destruction. No blood, gore, or graphic violence. Online multiplayer includes text chat with an optional profanity filter.
